description: This file defines utility functions for checking verification statuses related to Matrix devices, utilizing the MatrixDeviceVerificationStatusLike type.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified( isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified
methods.description: Checks if the device is locally verified based on the 'localVerified' property.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified( isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Checks if the device is verified by cross-signing or signed by owner.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient( isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient
methods.description: Determines if the device is verified in the current client by checking multiple verification conditions.
